title: Balloon Installment Percentages and Maturity Letter Timing for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contracts
content:
On the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract the final balloon installment is a percentage of the vehicle's MSRP that depends on the tier and the contract term. A term not listed for a tier is not offered as a balloon contract on that tier.

## Balloon installment as a percentage of vehicle MSRP

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Balloon for a 24-month term | 54% | 56% | 57% | 58% | 59% | 60% |
| Balloon for a 36-month term | 46% | 48% | 49% | 50% | 51% | 52% |
| Balloon for a 48-month term | 38% | 40% | 41% | 42% | 43% | 44% |
| Balloon for a 60-month term | not offered | 32% | 33% | 34% | 35% | 36% |

## Maturity options letter

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maturity options letter mailed, calendar days before the maturity date | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

## Points of reading

- Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 5 lists 24, 36 and 48-month terms only; a 60-month balloon term is not offered on Tier 5.
- The percentage applies to the vehicle MSRP recorded on the contract, not to the selling price or the amount financed.
- *Hypothetical illustration (generic figures):* a Tier 3 contract on a 36-month term for a vehicle with an MSRP of USD 40000.00 carries a balloon of 49 percent of MSRP, USD 19600.00.
